reviews.text: Love for animals, respect, care, kindness, and professionalism! That's why I chose them. They've built my loyalty without making me loyal, simply through affection. I have two dogs with different needs, and I wouldn't change them for anything in the world. Those who truly care about their furry children choose them.
Very good and attentive. Highly recommended.

Wonderful 🩵 I recommend them!
Hugs from Margot …

I take my two huskies to get washed and I'm always happy with the results. They're yellow and come out snow-white and smell amazing. The staff are super kind and patient. My dog ​​Masha isn't particularly fond of being washed or handled, and even though she throws a tantrum during the wash, the staff never loses their smile and cuddles her even more, completing the wash with so much love. They're special, highly recommended!
My dog ​​felt right at home with them right away. Very kind and professional, highly recommended! ✨
